methodology.source_weight_basis: Nikko AM Singapore STI ETF investment fair values. The fund describes replication in substantially the same weights as the STI. Holdings are a proxy for historical index capitalisation weights, not direct issuer free-float shares.
methodology.custom_index_policy: Intersect documented December 2020 holdings with Singapore-listed stock series present at January 2021 month end. Renormalize matched fair values. Initialize fixed notional index units at January 2021 month-end adjusted closes, base 100. Units stay fixed and value weights drift with adjusted returns. No later-period market caps or future constituents are used. January-February 2021 are a descriptive backcast because the holdings were published on 25 February 2021.
limitations: This is not an official STI or exact S&P-style free-float index: the supplied data omit historical issuer shares, free-float factors and corporate-action divisor updates.
Only constituents present in the supplied price file are retained; excluded weights and coverage are reported.

Frozen initial units omit subsequent index reconstitutions, share issuance and free-float revisions. Adjusted closes approximate reinvested distributions and splits; they are not a fully audited total-return series.
The 2020 weight snapshot is published before all 2022-onward model fits and evaluated forecasts. The exact index paths are reconstructed from later-vintage adjusted prices.
A government mirror of STI history was checked but its current download only covered dates after the rental labels; it is not used as a benchmark or backfilled into this experiment.
